items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: when I was four my grandfather Maxwell, my father's father, gave me a cor-net.

ctx.x: What kind of instruments would they play?

Well, mostly violin, banjos, mandolins, guitars and when I was four my grandfather Maxwell, my father's father, gave me a cor-net. One of my uncles played cor-net and one played baritone horn. But they played mostly old Scotch-Irish songs or they played country music. My grandfather played country fiddle. He held it down on his stomach and played on his stomach, like a bass viol. And my mother played violin, but she had gone to Conservatory. She was a good violinist. So we all sat around and played in the…
Were there any brothers or sisters? You mentioned it was a large family.
